input.question: What year was the album "Chayanne" released?

documents.text: Chayanne (1987 album) Chayanne is the third album from Puerto Rican artist Chayanne, released on Sony on 1987, and his first album under that label. "Chayanne" is the first album by the singer released by CBS Columbia (now Sony Music Entretaiment) and was produced by Ronnie Foster. "Fiesta En America" and "Peligro de Amor" peaked at number four on the "Billboard" Hot Latin Tracks chart.
